```sql
SELECT poi_name
FROM pois
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
  AND ST_DWithin(
        pois.geometry::geography,
        (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lucille Ball Childhood Home%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Jamestown%' AND addr_state = 'NY' LIMIT 1)::geography,
        100000
      )
  AND ST_Azimuth(
        (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lucille Ball Childhood Home%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Jamestown%' AND addr_state = 'NY' LIMIT 1)::geography,
        pois.geometry::geography
      ) BETWEEN RADIANS(22.5) AND RADIANS(67.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry::geography <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lucille Ball Childhood Home%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Jamestown%' AND addr_state = 'NY' LIMIT 1)::geography
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT t.poi_name, ST_Distance(t.geometry::geography, s.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois t
CROSS JOIN (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Children''s Cultural Center of Native America%' LIMIT 1) s
CROSS JOIN (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sunrise Art Studio%' LIMIT 1) d
WHERE t.tourism = 'attraction'
  AND ST_Intersects(t.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, d.geometry)::geography, 10000))
ORDER BY t.geometry <-> d.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT poi_name, amenity, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_MakeLine(
    (SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Caldwell Woods%' LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Fox Meadow Park%' LIMIT 1)
  ) AS geometry
) r
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
  AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography, 1000)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> r.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT r.road_name, ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_MakePoint(-77.0369, 38.8977)::geography) AS distance_to_planet_word
FROM roads r
WHERE ST_Intersects(r.geometry, (
    SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(
        (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mario & Alberto De La Cruz Art Gallery%' LIMIT 1),
        (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Planet Word%' LIMIT 1)
    ), 100) AS buffered_route
))
AND r.highway IN ('primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential')
ORDER BY r.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Planet Word%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Virginia B Ball Center for Creative Inquiry%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Muncie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IN%'
  LIMIT 1
) AS target
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Daubenspeck Nature Reserve%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Indianapolis%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IN%'
  LIMIT 1
) AS start
WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine(start.geometry, target.geometry)::geography, 10000)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> ST_MakeLine(start.geometry, target.geometry)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT h.poi_name, h.addr_city, h.addr_state, ST_Distance(h.geometry::geography, r.geom_route::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois h
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_MakeLine(ST_Centroid(p.geometry), ST_Centroid(r.geometry)) AS geom_route
  FROM (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%American Folk Art Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%'
    LIMIT 1
  ) p,
  (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%River Edge Bird Sanctuary and Nature Trail%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%River Edge%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%'
    LIMIT 1
  ) r
) r
WHERE h.amenity = 'hotel'
  AND ST_DWithin(h.geometry::geography, r.geom_route::geography, 100000) -- 100 km buffer
ORDER BY h.geometry <-> r.geom_route
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT r.road_name, ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_Centroid(ST_Union(p.geometry, n.geometry)::geography)) AS distance_meters

  AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mount Hope Estate%' LIMIT 1), 10000)
  AND r.highway IN ('primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential', 'road')
ORDER BY r.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Charlotte''s Quest Nature Center%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql

    (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Chestatee Overlook%' LIMIT 1) AS b,
```

```sql
SELECT r.id, r.road_name, r.highway, r.sidewalk, r.foot, r.bicycle, r.cycleway
FROM roads r
JOIN pois p ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography)
JOIN (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Home2 Suites%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Colorado Springs%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CO%'
    LIMIT 1
```
